title: Field Relay Tower and Front Equipment Service Pad
description: One static field-relay equipment layout from the original communications scene direction; one scene and zero new standalone models. Four whole original types at unit scale: a full tapered triangular antenna tower in the rear zone, one entire open-front pierced-rail equipment cabinet and one complete tilted solar rack in the front service zone, and two whole original court-fence modules across the middle with a genuine one-metre opening. A single new6.4x6.6x.16m closed scene-only ground pad connects the front equipment area and the rear tower area. The complete source GLB meshes, oriented triangles, static poses and per-face opaque PBR remain unchanged except declared translations and collision-safe names. Original equipment feet meet the pad top; full object envelopes remain separated with a continuous open front floor band.71meshes7644tri16PBR. Distinct from the earlier small reflector/cabinet/radio communications station and the unfenced offgrid wind-turbine/solar/cabinet grouping: this layout separates a tall antenna zone from a front-facing equipment-service zone with a clear central visual opening. No new tower segment, changed antenna angle, recolour, extracted component, cable, power link or communication function is invented. Not a demonstrated relay, transmitting system, electrical installation, secure enclosure, human-accessibility plan, construction/structural/load or safety certification. Original dynamic hierarchy and custom corner normals are not claimed preserved; original static world geometry is. Preview ground excluded.
